skill.name: pg
skill.description: Tunes and designs PostgreSQL: indexing, EXPLAIN-driven query optimization, schema types, safe migrations, vacuum, connection pooling. Use when writing Postgres SQL, designing schemas, running production DDL, or debugging slow queries.
skill.summary: When To Use - A Postgres query is slow, or an EXPLAIN plan needs interpretation - Designing a schema: types, constraints, indexes, keys - Running DDL or a migration against a live production table - Operating Postgres: c
